argument_markdown:
Proved steps.

1. With the packet convention W_f=(O_{P(E^∨)}(2)⊗gamma^*O(-f))|_C, SRC-0004 gives deg W_f=4g+12-4f. Thus deg W_5=4·6+12-20=16 and deg L=16-deg omega_C=16-10=6.

2. Riemann–Roch on each smooth connected genus-6 fibre gives chi(L)=6-6+1=1, hence h^0(L)=1+h^1(L)≥1. This excludes an h^0=0 stratum but does not determine the jumping strata.

3. For Gamma=p_1+⋯+p_6, SRC-0004 gives deg(omega_C⊗W_4^∨(Gamma))=-4, so the f=4 obstruction space vanishes. For f=5 the corresponding degree is zero. A degree-zero line bundle on a smooth projective connected curve has a nonzero section exactly when it is trivial. Therefore H^0(omega_C⊗W_5^∨(Gamma))≠0 iff omega_C⊗W_5^∨(Gamma)≅O_C, equivalently O_C(Gamma)≅W_5⊗omega_C^{-1}=L. By the packet's six-point failure criterion, this is exactly evaluation failure on geometric fibres.

4. The Abel map from the ordered relative configuration stack sends (C,p_1,…,p_6) to O_C(Gamma) in Pic^6. The line bundle L supplies a section of the same relative Picard stack. Define I as their fibre product and define Z as the determinantal evaluation-failure locus. Step 3 shows |I|=|Z| on geometric points. Consequently their reduced induced substacks agree: I_red=Z_red. This conclusion deliberately does not identify their nonreduced scheme structures.

5. Forgetting the ordering maps the ordered distinct-divisor incidence locus onto the reduced-support open of the effective-divisor incidence space. Permuting the six disjoint sections acts freely, and étale-locally a reduced degree-six divisor splits into its six sections. Hence the ordering map is a finite étale S_6-torsor. The reduced-support locus is open, not closed.

Source-backed inputs.

The CE convention, its negative twist gamma^*O(-5), the degree formula, the balanced splitting, the six-point failure criterion, and the finite étale ordering description are supplied by packet C66-001-v3 through SRC-0004 and its canonical geometric bottleneck.

Working contexts checked but not treated as proof.

The candidate and warning material in artifacts db338b111f175f57, 4916d72dc34c6c7c, 11878baf5e96cb76, a97039011ecf21cc, and 56648a8465662b01 was read. In particular, their warnings against inferring scheme equality from geometric points and against writing the whole incidence space as Proj(pi_*L) are respected by passing only to reduced substacks and using the Abel–Jacobi fibre product.

Computational hypotheses.

None.

Gaps.

The equality of the full determinantal/Fitting scheme with the Abel–Jacobi incidence scheme, including nilpotents and multiplicities, is not proved. The identification W_5≅omega_C^2(-D), the h^0-stratification, components, dimensions, stabilizers beyond the free S_6-action, closure across nonreduced markings or other splitting types, and every cohomological/Tate assertion remain open.

claims.statement: For every geometric ordered distinct degree-six divisor Gamma, evaluation fails exactly when O_C(Gamma)≅W_5⊗omega_C^{-1}.
The reduced evaluation-failure substack equals the reduced Abel–Jacobi incidence substack.
Ordering the six points gives a finite étale S_6-torsor over the reduced-support open.

novelty_claims: The reduced-substack formulation gives a rigorous weakest identification while avoiding the unsupported equality of determinantal and Abel–Jacobi nonreduced scheme structures.
summary: The ordered reduced evaluation-failure locus is constructed and identified, at the weakest scheme-theoretic level justified by the packet, as the reduced Abel–Jacobi incidence locus for the degree-six bundle W_5⊗omega_C^{-1}. No claim is made about nilpotent or determinantal multiplicities, global components, dimensions, or the exact Tate target.
theorem_statement: Let B^{bal} be the moduli stack of smooth genus-6 degree-four covers gamma:C→P^1 equipped with balanced Casnati–Ekedahl splitting F=O_{P^1}(4)⊕O_{P^1}(5), and put W_5=(O_{P(E^∨)}(2)⊗gamma^*O_{P^1}(-5))|_C and L=W_5⊗omega_C^{-1}. On Conf_6(C/B^{bal}), the stack of six ordered pairwise-distinct sections, the reduced evaluation-failure locus Z_red is exactly the reduced Abel–Jacobi incidence locus defined by O_C(p_1+⋯+p_6)≅L. Its quotient by S_6 is the reduced-support open in the relative effective-divisor incidence space for L, and Z_red→Z_red/S_6 is a finite étale S_6-torsor. Fibrewise deg L=6, chi(L)=1, and h^0(L)≥1.
